# 👤 Mort

Funeral director. Runs It's Your Funeral Home & Crematorium, next door on [[Ocean Avenue]], and has been Dad's friend for years — the kind who actually turns up. The business does custom themed funerals and caskets, which he discusses with the enthusiasm of a man who loves his work. He lives above the parlor, in an apartment furnished almost entirely with things people died on. Black tuxedo, purple tie, toupée, hearse.

Not involved in the job and does not want to be. Louise talks to him anyway, because he is the only adult on the street who answers a direct question directly. First names get muddled in transcripts, so a bare [[Mort]] reference is flagged rather than guessed at.
